results.question: Which suppliers have products with an average rating above 4.5? Show supplier names and average ratings.
results.initial_sql:
WITH avg_ratings AS (
    SELECT 
        p.supplier_id,
        AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating
    FROM 
        products p
    JOIN 
        reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id
    GROUP BY 
        p.supplier_id
    HAVING 
        AVG(r.rating) > 4.5
)
SELECT 
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    ar.average_rating
FROM 
    suppliers s
JOIN 
    avg_ratings ar ON s.supplier_id = ar.supplier_id;

results.question: Which customers have placed orders in at least three different calendar months? Show their IDs and names.
results.initial_sql:
WITH order_months AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) AS order_month
    FROM
        orders
    WHERE
        status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled', 'returned')
)
SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.full_name
FROM
    customers c
WHERE
    c.customer_id IN (
        SELECT
            customer_id
        FROM
            order_months
        GROUP BY
            customer_id
        HAVING
            COUNT(DISTINCT order_month) >= 3
    )

        COUNT(*) AS delivered_order_count
    FROM
        orders o

        customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE
        o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY
        o.customer_id, c.city
    HAVING
        COUNT(*) >= 5
)

results.question: For each order status, show the average number of items per order, counting item quantities rather than order-item rows.

    SELECT
        status,
        COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
    FROM
        orders
    GROUP BY
        status
),

    SELECT
        order_id,
        SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM
        order_items
    GROUP BY
        order_id
)

    os.status,
    COUNT(oic.order_id) / os.order_count AS average_items_per_order
FROM
    order_status_counts os
LEFT JOIN
    order_item_totals oic
ON
    os.order_id = oic.order_id
GROUP BY
    os.status;
